name: The Raven
summary:
Step inside the mind of a literary legend.

"The Raven" invites students and literature enthusiasts into a hauntingly beautiful 180° stereoscopic VR experience. Witness Edgar Allan Poe in his abandoned mansion, tormented by the loss of his wife and teetering on the edge of madness.
